rung: canonical two-seed sequential opaque-binding residual-slot acquisition
claim_boundary: Two independently bound residual slots acquire the same colliding geometry without cross-slot parameter interference; verifier promotion freezes each slot, a full bank rejects a third allocation, and a copy-on-write candidate safely reuses one slot for a new binding while the base and controller remain frozen. This is a narrow routing/lifecycle boundary, not autonomous binding discovery or general continual learning.

accounting.stable_bits_to_threshold: 1000 base updates plus 72 fresh scalar utilities for each of two opaque bindings; both slots acquired and retained on both seeds
accounting.retention_on_mastered_primitives: slot A retained after slot B growth; stable keep and disjoint replace retained for both bindings
accounting.lifecycle: both slots verifier-promoted and frozen; frozen updates rejected; third slot rejected at max_slots=2; unsafe replacement rejected and verified slot reuse accepted
accounting.transfer_ratio_against_geometry_only_bas: base partial replacement was 0.0078/0.0156; after two binding slots it was 0.9688/0.9375 for A and 0.8516/0.8828 for B

controls: same relational bank geometry across bindings
slot B unchanged during slot A learning
slot A unchanged during slot B learning
negative_control: 96 updates per slot caused stable retention collapse on seed 17 despite perfect partial replacement, demonstrating that residual growth needs a verifier-gated stopping/consolidation policy.
next_bottleneck: Learn when to allocate, stop, consolidate, compress, or evict residual slots without task labels, including online redundancy detection and long-horizon replacement under interference.
